Verify real React normal/StrictMode desktop/mobile account switch, response reordering and unmount paths, preserving all prior reliability gates. Propagate account ownership to the actual optional provider result handler; preserve both valid same-account completions when profile reads reorder. Pin the exact subscription account visit across provider recording and result presentation, including switches away and back to the same UID. Bind access and category preloading to the exact rendered account visit, rejecting stale access continuations before another request. Keep preloaded categories and avoid repeated access/catalog requests on same-account profile notifications, while switches away and back start a fresh visit. Prevent cached categories from appearing in any committed replacement frame before passive cleanup, including changed account visits, locales, authorities, deep links or locale eligibility. Verify populated-cache replacement, sign-out and deep-link catalog suppression in normal/StrictMode desktop/mobile browsers.
